title: Support kexec reboot from GUI
line: Restarting from Plasma now boots straight into a kexec kernel when one has been loaded, skipping the firmware like systemctl reboot does.
explanation: Plasma's Restart called logind's plain Reboot(true), which always goes through the firmware, so a kexec kernel the user had loaded (kexec --load, or systemctl kexec's systemd-boot entry) was ignored; `systemctl reboot` on the other hand kexecs automatically in that case. The session backend now calls logind's RebootWithFlags with SD_LOGIND_KEXEC_REBOOT (with interactive authorization allowed, as before), which logind turns into a kexec only when a kernel is loaded and into a normal reboot otherwise. On logind older than v254, which doesn't know the method or flag, it falls back to the old Reboot(true) call.

commits.message:
libkworkspace: restart into a loaded kexec kernel like systemctl reboot

Restarting from Plasma always did a full firmware reboot, even when a
kexec kernel had been loaded to skip it. Ask logind to reboot with the
kexec flag, falling back to the plain call on logind older than v254.

BUG: 458809

media.caption: Master: Restart (logout greeter's path, plasma-shutdown logoutAndReboot) sends logind Reboot(true), a full firmware reboot even with a kexec kernel loaded
With the fix: Restart sends RebootWithFlags(SD_LOGIND_KEXEC_REBOOT), so logind kexecs when a kernel is loaded

reviews.text: This patch does not actually implement GUI kexec reboot as requested in bug 458809. It adds no GUI option and does not load a kexec kernel, only changing LogindSessionBackend::reboot() to pass SD_LOGIND_KEXEC_REBOOT to logind's RebootWithFlags, which is a no-op unless the user has already loaded a kernel manually as root beforehand. On the stock systemd-boot setup the reporter explicitly cited, clicking Restart still performs a full firmware reboot, and if a user were to pre-load a kernel manually they would also lose the ability to choose a normal firmware reboot from Plasma. Closing this wish with BUG: 458809 would falsely mark it as implemented.
changes: Do not close bug 458809 by only adding SD_LOGIND_KEXEC_REBOOT to the regular Restart call, as it does not enable kexec reboot out of the box on systemd-boot systems.

To implement the requested feature, add a mechanism that actually loads the kexec kernel (via upstream systemd/logind support or a privileged helper) and expose a dedicated kexec / fast-reboot action in session management and the Plasma UI so users can choose between a normal firmware reboot and a kexec reboot.

reviews.text: Calling logind's RebootWithFlags(SD_LOGIND_KEXEC_REBOOT), with a fallback to Reboot(true) on UnknownMethod/InvalidArgs, is a clean, correct-layer change that makes Plasma's Restart match systemctl reboot. But it only matters when a kexec kernel is already loaded, and no default system has one: an unprivileged user can't load one, and the reporter's systemd-boot case ('works pretty much for free') relies on systemctl kexec loading the boot entry as root. So the wish (reboot via kexec from the GUI, Nate's 'fast boot') stays unmet for practically everyone. The evidence is only a D-Bus mock trace with no real kexec, which is fair for the rig but proves only the call, not the user-visible result.
changes: Either deliver a GUI path that actually kexecs on a default system (e.g. a 'Fast Restart'/kexec action that loads the default boot entry through a privileged helper or kexec.target via polkit, shown only where supported), or land this as a consistency change with CCBUG: 458809 instead of BUG:.
If kept as BUG:, show a real end-to-end kexec reboot (VM is fine), not only the mock logind call log.
